steps.latex: (1,8), (2,7), (3,6), (4,5) \text{ there are 4 pairs that sum to 9. by the pigeonhole principle, if we choose 5 numbers from these 8, at least one pair will be selected. the pigeons are the 5 selected numbers, the pigeonholes are the four pairs. }
